Blog Outline Generator

Turn any topic into a blog post skeleton — 5 title options, an H2/H3 outline, and an intro hook, all ready to copy.

📖 How to use

  1. Type your blog topic.
  2. Press Generate Outline.
  3. Copy titles individually or the whole outline.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What does it generate?

Type your topic and get 5 clickable title options plus a full H2/H3 section outline and an intro hook paragraph.

How is the outline structured?

The outline adapts: it builds an intro, 5 body sections with sub-points, and a conclusion around your topic.

Can I copy the whole outline?

Yes — a Copy All button copies the entire outline, or copy individual titles.
